hero.headline: Pest control and food safety across the Canary Islands
hero.sub: Since 2011 we have looked after homes, communities, hotels and restaurants on all 8 islands. Tell us what is happening and we will advise you.

pests.title: Pest control
pests.intro: We inspect, find where the problem starts and treat with authorised biocide products. Then we put preventive measures in place so it stays away.

cards.name: Insect control
cards.text: Cockroaches, ants, fleas, flies and mosquitoes in homes, premises and businesses.

cards.name: Rodent control
cards.text: Rats and mice handled with a prior inspection and preventive follow-up.

cards.name: Disinfection
cards.text: Treatment against viruses, bacteria and fungi. Also for large surfaces such as warehouses, supermarkets or sports facilities, using fogging and controlled micro-diffusion.

cards.name: Bird control
cards.text: Nets, spikes and tensioned wires against pigeons and other birds on buildings, roofs and hotels. Animals are not harmed.

cards.name: Woodworm and termites
cards.text: Wood treatment for structures, furniture and houses, including subterranean termites.

cards.name: Pest control certificates
cards.text: Official certificate of the treatments carried out, useful for health inspections and audits.

health.title: Public health and food safety
health.intro: We help restaurants, shops, food producers, businesses and public bodies meet health regulations, with advice and paperwork handled for them.

cards.name: HACCP (APPCC)
cards.text: Hazard analysis and critical control point plans tailored to your activity.

cards.name: Food-handler training
cards.text: Personal hygiene, cross-contamination, temperatures and storage for hospitality and retail teams.

cards.name: Legionella treatment
cards.text: Control and prevention in domestic water systems, cooling towers and spas, with disinfection and water analysis.

cards.name: Food quality and safety management
cards.text: Process control, traceability and risk management for food businesses.

cards.name: Food safety crisis support
cards.text: Technical support when an alert or incident affects food safety.

cards.name: Public health consulting
cards.text: Risk assessment, preventive measures and ongoing control of hygiene and health processes.

cards.name: Public Health paperwork
cards.text: Registrations, health authorisations and prior notifications to the Dirección General de Salud Pública.
